name: Choose Me!
source:
Meguru and his friends, Kyou and Rei, have gotten trapped in a room they can't leave unless one of them is sacrificed!

To leave this room, one of them will have to die.

Meguru doesn't want anyone dead, so what is he going to do...?

――Will he save himself or his friends?

――Who on earth trapped them there?

――Why are they forced to make this choice?

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20377]Freem![/url]]
translation:
Meguru和他的朋友Kyou和Rei被困在一个房间里，除非牺牲其中一人，否则他们无法离开！

要离开这个房间，他们中的一个人必须死。

Meguru不想让任何人死，那么他要做什么……？

——他会拯救自己还是朋友们？

——到底是谁把他们困在那里的？

――为什么他们会被迫做出这样的选择呢？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20377]Freem![/url]]
